response.overview: One of the artist's old possessions forms the structure’s shell. Broken, run down, and dusty is the instrument; it appears that the creator insists the degradation of one's original dreams, now simply the husk for the one replaced inside. Intricate, busy, and labored within, its ever growing spread breaks down the confines, leaving the instrument not solely a husk but particulates as the cycle continues.
response.title: Imahe ng Musika
